sections.text: Join us on 27th August for a discussion on how you can establish your legal rights when facing redundancy.
As the government’s ‘furlough’ scheme comes to an end, the economic impact of COVID-19 means that many employees will now be at risk of redundancy.

This webinar will outline what a fair process should look like, what rights to alternative job roles you might have, and in what circumstances you will be entitled to a redundancy payment (and how much you can expect should you receive one). It will also briefly outline how you can take action if you think your employer has acted unlawfully.
Please note that although we may use case studies as examples, we will not be able to answer specific enquiries about individual cases and situations.
